title: Distribute Candies Among Children III
summary: Given positive integers n and limit, calculate the number of ways to distribute n candies among 3 children with each child receiving no more than limit candies.
statement: Given positive integers n and limit, calculate the number of ways to distribute n candies among 3 children with each child receiving no more than limit candies.
constraints: Distribute exactly n identical candies among three children.
Each child receives at most limit candies; return the number of ordered distributions.
hints: Start with all nonnegative solutions and exclude children exceeding the limit.
Apply inclusion-exclusion to three identical upper-bound violations.
Use C(total+2,2), subtract three shifted counts, add three double intersections, subtract the triple intersection.
Shifting an over-limit child by limit+1 bijects violations with an unrestricted smaller-sum distribution.
editorial: Shifting an over-limit child by limit+1 bijects violations with an unrestricted smaller-sum distribution.

tests.explanation: Only permutations of 1,2,2 are valid, giving three distributions.
All ten unrestricted distributions already respect the limit.
